rationale.conceptual: The work applies an established semiempirical method to a known minicrystal protocol; implementing the exact iterative partial‑optimisation and reconstruction logic, including space‑group symmetry handling and proper interfacing with PM3 software, requires genuine understanding and careful implementation of the paper's described procedure. rationale.execution: The pipeline demands building 27‑residue crystal models for six carbohydrates, installing and driving a semiempirical QM code (e.g., MOPAC) in an iterative loop with two GNORM thresholds, and collating lattice energies. This is a multi‑stage workflow with environment setup, scripting of input generation/output parsing, and handling of up to ~16 optimization cycles per molecule; it is more than a simple script but does not involve very long or fragile orchestration.
